unit.why: An anecdote of an encounter between the Berdichever and the Seer of Lublin about saying ruach ha-kodesh, with the son's follow-up question and the Seer's answer.

stories.start_quote: פ"א הי' הרה"ק מבארדיטשוב אצל הרב מלובלין
stories.summary_en: When the Berdichever visits him, he asks the Seer of Lublin to justify 'saying ruach ha-kodesh'. The Seer offers to stop if told to, and the Berdichever permits it. The Seer's son R. Yosef later asks how he could make his practice depend on the Berdichever. The Seer answers that he already knew through ruach ha-kodesh that the Berdichever would agree.

tags.why: the Seer foreknew the Berdichever's consent through ruach ha-kodesh
